name: 37-celestial-stag
description: Celestial Stag: a slender stag of the deep mines, its coat the purple of the reality-shard cave, lilac stars on its back, antlers like the cave torches' rainbow flame. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place: it breathes, lowers its glowing antlers and raises them again, the rainbow flame on its antlers flickering. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
